title: Egypt's Hidden Pharaohs | Royal Cache · Shorts15 V2
script:
Egypt's greatest pharaohs were hidden!

Robbers came. Priests moved royal mummies to safety.

Inside TT320, they hid kings together.

Watch the full Royal Cache.

production.visual: Hook: vivid, dominant Royal Portrait, then sudden cut to the hidden coffin. Two distinct beats in the first three seconds.
production.sound: Urgent original score with a hit on first frame, then quick sting.

scenes.narration: Robbers came. Priests moved royal mummies to safety.
scenes.label: TOMBS ROBBED

production.visual: Three shots, 0-1.67s: intruder with torch by robbed coffin; 1.67-3.33s: priests actively rewrap burial; 3.33-5s: bearers move a coffin beneath the cliffs.
production.sound: Stone scrape, linen rustle, desert wind. Event Foley is a production cue, not yet automatically executed.

scenes.narration: Inside TT320, they hid kings together.
scenes.label: THE SECRET SHAFT

production.visual: Three shots: descend into shaft, then cross-sectional schematic of corridors and cache, then atmospheric closeup of three coffins. Artistic reconstruction, not measured archaeological plan.
production.sound: Descending bass, quick reveal hit, quiet torch crackle.

production.visual: Two shots: close royal burial discovery then full high contrast title card. YouTube Related Video must be attached in Studio after publishing.
production.sound: Short resolving chord; no overlong silence.
